repairs.disposition: Source-supported scope correction: a local source observation does not require the later unrelated stubbed test. Does not settle whole claim.

range: Two local helper subjects, one aggregate reported inspection/refactor/test episode. No repeatable whole-claim certification process established.
limits: Absence of direct DB calls in selected source is not absence of effects in all callees or remote configuration.
Trello HTTP writes are real side effects; do not rename the claim to no side effects.
Historical report says 96 comparisons; saved report says 88. Preserve both provenance records and do not use the count as proof.
Authentication implementation audit is outside scope under R3.
abstraction: Evidence-work process; application execution is an observed check result, not simulated database behavior.
event_wording: Action granularity and short names are analyst choices; observations retain source references.
state_semantics: Guards are AND clauses, with OR across clauses. A replay event has enabled, occurring and accomplished-but-not-depleted phases. Phase expansion is a modeling convention, not measured timing. Repeated checks are new occurrences; evidence is reusable, not consumed by being read.

commutation_checks.basis: B-R3; provisional source-derived independence, not a real-world scheduling experiment
